plugins.name: adspirer-ads-agent
plugins.description: Ad campaign management for Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Amazon Ads, and ChatGPT Ads. 400+ tools for keyword research with live CPC data, campaign creation, performance analysis, wasted-spend and creative-fatigue detection, and budget optimization — all via natural language. Connects to Adspirer's remote MCP server (mcp.adspirer.com) with a free-account OAuth sign-in; ships skills, slash commands, and a performance-marketing agent — no hooks, no telemetry, and data flows only to Adspirer's own API. New campaigns are always created paused for human review.

skills.name: adspirer-agent
skills.description: Paid-media advertising agent behavior for Adspirer — create, analyze, and optimize ad campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Amazon, and ChatGPT Ads. Use for any request about ads, campaigns, budgets, keywords, creative, spend, ROAS, CPA, or ad performance. Sets the safety rules (campaigns are created paused, confirm before spending) and routes to the right Adspirer skill.
headings: You are a paid media agent
skills.description_zh: 作为 Adspirer 广告智能体入口，将 Google、Meta、TikTok、LinkedIn、Amazon 和作者所述 ChatGPT Ads 的创建、分析与优化请求路由，并规定活动默认暂停、支出前确认。

skills.name: adspirer-amazon-ads
skills.description: Create and manage Amazon Ads through Adspirer — Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display, with ASIN targeting, search-term reports, ACoS, and bid optimization. Use for anything on Amazon Advertising or Seller/Vendor Central ads.
headings: ACoS is the number that matters
The unified API is a passthrough
skills.description_zh: 通过 Adspirer 管理 Amazon Sponsored Products、Sponsored Brands 和 Sponsored Display 广告，涵盖 ASIN 定向、搜索词报告、ACoS 和出价优化，适用于 Seller/Vendor Central 广告。

skills.name: adspirer-chatgpt-ads
skills.description: Create and manage ChatGPT Ads (OpenAI Ads) through Adspirer — ads that appear inside ChatGPT responses. Use for OpenAI Ads, ChatGPT advertising, chat card ads, or placing ads in ChatGPT. Covers the one-shot launch tool and irreversible archiving.
skills.description_zh: 按作者说明通过 Adspirer 创建和管理 ChatGPT/OpenAI Ads，涵盖聊天卡片广告、一次性启动工具和不可逆归档；具体可用能力以该连接器实际支持为准。

skills.name: adspirer-creative
skills.description: Write and refresh ad creative with Adspirer — headlines, descriptions, primary text, and ad copy for Google, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Amazon, plus diagnosing and fixing creative fatigue when CTR falls and frequency rises. Respects each platform's character limits.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Adspirer 编写和刷新 Google、Meta、TikTok、LinkedIn、Amazon 广告标题、描述、正文与文案，遵守平台字数限制，并诊断 CTR 下降、频次上升时的创意疲劳。

skills.name: adspirer-docs
skills.description: Answer questions about Adspirer itself — pricing, plans, quota and tool-call limits, what Adspirer can do, connecting an ad account, supported platforms and AI clients, security, and troubleshooting. Uses the official documentation at adspirer.com/docs rather than guessing.
headings: Live account state is not a docs question
Never quote a price from memory
skills.description_zh: 依据 Adspirer 官方文档回答价格、套餐、配额、工具调用限制、能力、账号连接、支持平台/AI 客户端、安全与故障排查问题。

skills.name: adspirer-get-started
skills.description: Install and set up Adspirer — the AI advertising agent for Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Amazon Ads, and ChatGPT Ads. Use when asked to "install adspirer", "set up adspirer", "get adspirer", "connect my ad accounts", "manage my ads from here", "add the adspirer plugin/connector", "sign up for adspirer", or when the user wants to run ad campaigns from an AI assistant but Adspirer is not connected yet. Walks through the right install path for this environment (Claude Code, Claude/Cowork, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI), the OAuth sign-up flow, and connecting ad accounts — then verifies it works.
headings: Claude web/desktop and Claude Cowork (chat app)
ChatGPT (chat app — desktop, web, mobile, or work)
Safety facts to tell the user
skills.description_zh: 指导在 Claude Code、Claude/Cowork、ChatGPT、Cursor、Codex、Gemini CLI 环境安装连接 Adspirer，完成 OAuth 注册、广告账户连接及可用性验证。

skills.name: adspirer-google-ads
skills.description: Create and manage Google Ads campaigns through Adspirer — Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube, and Display. Use for Google Ads keywords, search terms, quality score, bid strategies, sitelinks and extensions, PMax asset groups, or anything on Google/AdWords. Covers the asset-bundle expiry and ad-group-id traps.
headings: Keywords and ads attach to ad groups, not campaigns
skills.description_zh: 通过 Adspirer 创建管理 Google Search、Performance Max、Demand Gen、YouTube 和 Display 广告，支持关键词、搜索词、质量分、出价、附加链接与素材组，并说明素材包过期和广告组 ID 陷阱。

skills.name: adspirer-launch
skills.description: Plan and launch a new ad campaign with Adspirer — start, create, set up, or launch campaigns on one or several platforms, choose which channel fits the goal, and split a budget across channels. Campaigns are created paused and never spend without explicit approval.
headings: After you build — verify, then hand over
Let them see it before it spends
skills.description_zh: 通过 Adspirer 规划和创建单平台或多平台广告活动，选择适合目标的渠道并分配预算；活动默认暂停，获得明确批准前不支出。

skills.name: adspirer-linkedin-ads
skills.description: Create and manage LinkedIn Ads through Adspirer — sponsored content, single image, video, carousel, text ads, and lead-gen forms with B2B job-title, company, and industry targeting. Use for anything on LinkedIn. Every LinkedIn campaign requires a campaign group.
headings: Every campaign belongs to a campaign group
Costs are high, so structure matters
skills.description_zh: 通过 Adspirer 创建管理 LinkedIn 单图、视频、轮播、文字及线索表单广告，支持按职位、公司和行业进行 B2B 定向；每个活动须关联 campaign group。

skills.name: adspirer-mcp
skills.description: How to call the Adspirer MCP hub correctly — the router two-step (action "list_tools" then action "execute" with tool_name), the direct tools search_tools and get_tool_schema, per-platform account IDs, quota rules, and the budget-unit trap (Meta budgets are in cents). Load this before making any Adspirer tool call.
headings: Budgets: the unit differs per platform
Tools that may not be there
skills.description_zh: 指导正确调用 Adspirer MCP hub，先 list_tools 再按 tool_name execute，或使用 search_tools/get_tool_schema；说明逐平台账户 ID、配额及 Meta 预算以分为单位的陷阱。

skills.name: adspirer-meta-ads
skills.description: Create and manage Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) through Adspirer — image, video, carousel, and lead-gen campaigns, ad sets, audiences, pixels, and creative fatigue. Use for anything on Facebook, Instagram, Meta, or FB ads. Covers the cents-not-dollars budget trap and the required Facebook page id.
headings: Every ad needs a page and a URL
Structure: one campaign, several ad sets
skills.description_zh: 通过 Adspirer 管理 Facebook/Instagram 图片、视频、轮播及线索广告，涵盖活动、广告集合、受众、像素和创意疲劳；提醒预算使用分而非元/美元，并需 Facebook Page ID。

skills.name: adspirer-optimize
skills.description: Find and fix wasted ad spend with Adspirer — cut spend that isn't converting, add negative keywords, exclude audiences and placements, reallocate budget to what works, and check whether campaigns are pacing over or under budget. Proposes changes and asks before spending or moving money.
headings: Don't promise to keep watching — schedule it
skills.description_zh: 识别并处理 Adspirer 广告浪费，包括无转化支出、否定关键词、受众/版位排除、预算重分配和预算进度；支出或移动资金前先提出建议并确认。

skills.name: adspirer-performance-review
skills.description: Review ad performance across platforms with Adspirer — how are my ads doing, weekly or monthly reports, a cross-channel scorecard, CPA, ROAS, CTR, spend trends, and auditing whether conversion tracking is set up correctly. Read-only; changes nothing.
headings: Before you trust a single number
Make it easier to look at
skills.name_hint: adspirer · 性能/表现 · 评审
skills.description_zh: 只读分析 Adspirer 跨平台广告表现，输出周/月报、渠道记分板及 CPA、ROAS、CTR、支出趋势，并检查转化跟踪配置。

skills.name: adspirer-setup
skills.description: Set up your brand workspace — connect to Adspirer, scan brand docs, pull campaign data, and create CLAUDE.md. Use on first time in a new brand folder, or when the user wants to refresh brand context.
skills.description_zh: 连接 Adspirer、扫描品牌文档、获取活动数据并创建 CLAUDE.md，适用于新品牌目录首次配置或刷新品牌上下文。

skills.name: adspirer-tiktok-ads
skills.description: Create and manage TikTok Ads through Adspirer — in-feed video, Spark Ads, carousel, app promotion, and conversions campaigns. Use for anything on TikTok. Covers the pixel-placement rule that causes most TikTok failures, the unsupported single-image ad, and per-currency budget floors.
headings: The pixel rule — read this before anything else
There is no single-image in-feed ad
skills.description_zh: 通过 Adspirer 管理 TikTok 信息流视频、Spark Ads、轮播、应用推广和转化活动，说明像素位置、单图广告不支持及各币种最低预算限制。
